title: Gardien yu jardin bi
intro: Ci biir jardin bu naat, askan wi dafa def waat bu am solo. Waaye seen yéene dafa natt ginaaw bi Yàlla duggee ci seen bopp, soppi seen xéewal nekk réew mu amul doom.
clues: Ñu barkeel nañu nu jardin bu bari, waaye nu dem ba réy.
Nu defar pexe ngir góob te baña séddoo ak néew ci doole yi.
Nu teela dem ci suba si, wóolu sunu pexe.
Waaye bi nu yegsee, nu gis ni sunu jardin dafa yàqu ci guddi gi.
Nu xam sunu njuumte, nu tàmbali ku nekk tuumal moroomam.
Nu mujjee tuub, waaye nu jàngee lu yàgg lool.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Xiif gu dal ci réew mi
Ngelaw lu metti luy dagg garab yi

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Ñu tuub seen bàkkaar waaye ñàkk seen jardin
outcome.answer: Ñu tuub seen bàkkaar waaye ñàkk seen jardin

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
